text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I worked really hard at today's 
training too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, as a reward, I'll watch the 
recorded sumo matches♪ I wonder what 
winning technique will—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No way, are you kidding me!? Even though 
it was the Yokozuna's... retirement 
match...!

"Having missed recording an important sumo 
bout, she sank into deep dejection..."
